description: This file defines a utility enum NodeDisplayName that provides functions to handle device display names, including checking if a name is generic, generating default names based on UI idioms, and resolving a display name based on existing data, device name, and UI idiom.

methods.name: isGeneric
methods.description: Checks if the provided device name is one of the generic names.

methods.name: defaultValue
methods.description: Provides a default display name based on the UI user interface idiom.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the display name based on existing name, device name, and UI idiom, applying normalization and default logic.
